task: Collect many free presentation reference files and convert them to HTML references.

expected_items.description: Run web-first intake before planning or implementation.
Collect many actual free/open presentation template files rather than only metadata.
expected_items.source: User asked to download many free PPT reference files.
expected_items.rationale: The collected raw files are LibreOffice Impress .otp templates, not PPTX files; the format limitation is documented.

expected_items.description: Download only sources with clear raw-storage-compatible license notes.
expected_items.source: Presentation-agent collection policy and repository license rules.

expected_items.description: Convert collected references to HTML in a way that can be browsed later.
expected_items.rationale: The conversion is reference-only HTML using thumbnails, provenance, license notes, and extracted text; it is not high-fidelity visual rendering.

expected_items.description: Provide a UI/gallery for scanning the collected templates.
expected_items.source: User asked to collect files and UIs for reference.

expected_items.description: Record requirements, spec, provenance, plan evidence, request trace, work summary, timing, grounding, and evaluation.

artifact_checks.purpose: Open Impress collector and HTML reference generator.

acceptance_checks.description: Collect at least 100 raw presentation template files.
evidence: 119 .otp files collected and 119 registry records generated.

acceptance_checks.description: Generate HTML references for each collected template.
Generated gallery loads in browser on desktop and mobile.
evidence: Playwright gallery tests passed in chromium-desktop and chromium-mobile.

acceptance_checks.description: Registry explains purpose, references, structure rules, and fields.

known_omission_risks: This pass collected .otp Impress templates, not PPTX files.
High-fidelity visual conversion is not implemented because LibreOffice/soffice is not installed.
notes: The format and conversion limitations are documented in README, research, source notes, registry, and grounding records.
